metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of the Vendit System: counter checkout and service, merchandise and inventory, omnichannel commerce through Katapull sibling connectors, and insight, finance and platform services.

rootGroups.name: Store Checkout and Customer Service
rootGroups.description: Everything that happens at the counter and in the service area of a specialty store.

subGroups.name: Checkout and Payment
subGroups.description: Till, tenders, receipts and in-store hardware.

bricks.name: POS Checkout and Sales Registration
bricks.description: The till itself: scanning or searching articles, building the basket, applying prices, promotions and loyalty discounts, taking trade-ins and registering every sale on name or anonymously. Vendit positions this as fast, branch-specific checkout software running on Windows store workstations.

layers.description: User-facing screens and clients.

modules.name: POS Checkout Screen
modules.description: Touch-screen checkout client on the store workstation: scan, search, basket, discounts, trade-in and tender selection.
Calls sales api.

layers.description: APIs and backoffice interfaces exposed to other bricks and partners.

modules.name: Sales Registration API
modules.description: Registers baskets, returns and trade-ins and exposes sales to other bricks.
Calls basket pricing.
Calls sales transaction service.

layers.description: Asynchronous jobs, queues and scheduled daemons.

modules.name: Offline Sales Sync
modules.description: Keeps a local sales buffer on the workstation and syncs to the central database when the connection returns (assumed capability, not confirmed by Vendit).
Calls sales transaction service.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Basket Pricing Orchestrator
modules.description: Calls the price engine, loyalty and customer services to compute the final basket.
Uses Pricing, Promotions and Purchase Price Formulas.
Uses Loyalty, Value Cheques and Gift Cards.

layers.description: Services that own durable business state.

modules.name: Sales Transaction Service
modules.description: System of record for receipts, sale lines, returns, trade-ins and sales staff attribution.

brickDependencies.description: Selling price and active promotions per article and branch.
Every sale and return mutates the stock ledger in real time.
Starts card and other tender payments.
Looks up or creates the customer for sale on name.
Applies points, value cheques and vouchers.
Drives scanner, receipt printer and cash drawer.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for every receipt.
Article lookup by barcode and description.

bricks.name: Payment Terminal and Tender Integration
bricks.description: Connects the till to card terminals and alternative tenders (cash, gift cards, instalment payments) and records each tender. Vendit lists CCV, Worldline, Pay. and SprayPay among its payment partners.

layers.description: APIs and backoffice interfaces exposed to other bricks and partners.

modules.name: Payment Terminal API
modules.description: Start, cancel and confirm payments from the till.
Calls tender service.

layers.description: Services that own durable business state.

modules.name: Tender Service
modules.description: Records tenders, split payments and terminal results per receipt.

layers.description: Connectors to external systems and partners.

modules.name: Payment Terminal Connectors
modules.description: Connectors to card terminals and payment providers (CCV, Worldline, Pay.) and instalment payment (SprayPay).

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Authorises card payments at the counter.
Pay-later and instalment purchases for higher-value items.

bricks.name: Receipts, Cashbook and Day Closing
bricks.description: Prints or e-mails receipts, keeps the cash drawer and cashbook, and closes each register at the end of the day so turnover, tenders and cash differences reconcile before export to accounting.

layers.description: User-facing screens and clients.

modules.description: Counts the drawer, shows tender totals and explains differences.
Calls cashbook api.

layers.description: APIs and backoffice interfaces exposed to other bricks and partners.

modules.name: Cashbook API

Calls cashbook service.

layers.description: Asynchronous jobs, queues and scheduled daemons.

modules.name: Receipt Mailer
modules.description: Sends digital receipts and reprints on request.

layers.description: Services that own durable business state.

modules.name: Cashbook Service
modules.description: Owns per-register cashbook and closing records.

bricks.name: Store Hardware, Labels and Peripherals
bricks.description: Configures and drives the hardware Vendit supplies with the system: screens, scanners, receipt and label printers, cash drawers and handhelds (Vendit names Datalogic, Epson and Zebra), plus shelf labels and customer cards as supplies.

modules.description: Designs price labels, shelf cards and customer card layouts.
Calls device profile service.

layers.description: Services that own durable business state.

layers.description: Connectors to external systems and partners.

modules.description: Drivers for Epson printers, Datalogic and Zebra scanners and label printers.

brickDependencies.description: Article and price data for labels.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Printing and scanning at the counter.

subGroups.name: Customers, Orders and Service

bricks.description: Registers, schedules and tracks repair orders for bike workshops, jewellers and electronics stores, with status updates to customers and billing of parts and labour at pickup. Vendit highlights workshop functions for two-wheelers and repair registration for jewellers.

subGroups.name: Stock and Purchasing

rootGroups.name: Omnichannel Commerce
